fields.label: Title
fields.value: Letter from Edwin A. Shanke to parents, December 11, 1937

fields.label: Description
fields.value: Typewritten letter from Edwin A. Shanke to his parents, December 11, 1937. Written from Berlin, Shanke continues to discuss German customs, particularly church collection policies.
